Subject: Vendor onboarding: insurance docs & PO steps for SecureCloud

Hi Lina —

Welcome aboard and thanks for moving quickly on this. To finish vendor setup in our system we need a couple of standard items from SecureCloud so Finance and Legal can issue a PO and finalize the SOW: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) that names Redwood Inference, Inc. as certificate holder and includes Additional Insured endorsement (General Liability & Auto).
- W-9 or equivalent tax form.
- Vendor risk questionnaire answers (we attach a short form below).
- Primary carrier contact and policy effective/expiration dates.

PO process notes: for services > $5,000 we require a signed SOW and a PO (Net 30 by default). Stephanie Nguyen on Finance will issue the PO once insurance and W-9 are validated. Legal may request an endorsement or change to insurance wording — I’m looping them in.

Can you send the COI with the Additional Insured endorsement and the W-9 by EOD tomorrow (Tue)? If you prefer, you can attach the documents to this thread or share a secured link.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
David

Thanks for the thread. I reviewed SecureCloud's COI and the endorsement stub. A few notes / next steps from Legal: 

- Required confirmation: we need the actual Additional Insured endorsement rather than a stub or handwritten note. The endorsement must name "Redwood Inference, Inc." explicitly as Additional Insured.
- Wording: please confirm the endorsement includes Primary & Non-Contributory language and a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood where permitted by law.
- Limits: we require General Liability $2,000,000 per occurrence, Aggregate $4,000,000 or higher; Auto $1,000,000; E&O/Professional Liability $1,000,000. The attached COI shows compliance on occurrence limits but we need the full endorsement page.
- Carrier contact looks fine — please ask them to send the endorsement PDF and policy number and effective/expiration dates. If they prefer, the carrier can email legal@redwoodinference.com directly.

Finance / Procurement process reminders: once the endorsement is received and W-9 is validated, Finance (Stephanie) can issue a PO. For the SOW, include the clause that requires vendor to maintain the specified coverage during the term.

Priyom / David — can you please request the endorsement and policy number from Cedar Point and push the updated COI to this thread? If we receive it before EOD tomorrow, Legal can sign off quickly.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
